title: stats-off 1x1 placeholder is not a shape

commit.merge_subject: merge: stats-off 1x1 placeholder is not a shape

description:
The GPU preview path's stats-off fallback (GlesPreviewSession.cpp:1092)
publishes a 1x1 opaque-black PreviewFrame — the stats pack is the only
pixel payload the GPU path returns, so with the debug stats toggle off
every publish is that placeholder. PreviewSurfaceRatio.of tier 1 took
any positive frame dims as truth, so 1x1 -> ratio 1.0 -> a SQUARE
SurfaceView. Live trace (pid 21306, 21:23-21:25): source=4096x3072
(4:3) rendered surface=1080x810 first, then every render read
surface=1080x1080; source=3840x2160 (16:9) jumped 1080x607 -> 1080x1080;
every line read out=1x1 stats=off. The owner saw a tall/square preview
region for landscape clips and black windows.

Fix rule: a frame with BOTH sides <= 1 carries no shape information —
treat it as unknown and fall through to the source pair. A real square
frame (1000x1000) is still a shape; only the degenerate placeholder
(1x1, 0x1, 1x0) is sk
changed: fix: stats-off 1x1 placeholder is not a shape
